intervention: Apply uniqueness at each projected point rather than the entire RGB row. Compile observed/ambiguous candidate intervals, deduplicate exactly identical raw pairs, then count hits under the unchanged 1px padding. Exactly one hit gives one view vote; zero or multiple hits give zero. Require three distinct views. Nearest original row, no vertical dilation, no selecting a candidate or filling holes.
paired_policy: Same immutable full points, exported cameras, finite patches and downstream reader as the union arm. Both original whole-row unique and candidate-union arms remain frozen and reported. No geometry edits, point suppression or label-aware readout.
freeze_policy: Sequential development: prior whole-row and union physical scores have been seen. Local uniqueness was proposed in source-only diagnosis, but this run is not pre-registered with the union arm and not an independent holdout. Freeze analytic controls and all 18 outputs before this arm inference/scoring. No threshold sweep or post-score tuning.
qualification: Local interval uniqueness is only a photometric condition, not unique cross-view correspondence or foreground identity. Overlapping intervals abstain, including true rods; clutter and downstream false axes can remain. Preserve every rejection/regression. Not a general reader or G1 pass.
